text:
ashley: Quick favor — can someone run a smoke + short latency profile for shorebird-13b on the onboarding infra? Need 128-token perf and 512-token tail. Aim: 10 concurrent requests, batch sizes 1/4/8, kv cache warm/cold. Target: perf post in thread by EOD. @omar @raj
bench-bot: Bench job queued: job_id=jb-6132245566-1. Runner: ondock-4. Estimated 18m.
omar: Taking this. Will run 1) smoke 128 toks qps 10, 2) tail 512 toks samples 200, 3) kv warm vs cold. Any special tiling/quant flags?
ashley: Default quant=fp16 for now. If memory spikes >90% abort. Use tiling=auto.
omar: Got it. Starting now.
bench-bot: Bench job started: jb-6132245566-1 on ondock-4 at 6132245700
omar: Summary:
- 128 tokens (batch=1): p50=32ms p95=78ms p99=120ms throughput ~210 tok/s
- 128 tokens (batch=4): p50=28ms p95=65ms p99=110ms throughput ~770 tok/s
- 128 tokens (batch=8): p50=30ms p95=70ms p99=130ms throughput ~1500 tok/s
- 512 tokens (tail profile): p50=120ms p95=420ms p99=980ms
- KV cache: cold vs warm => cold p95 ~1.4x warm; warm (128t) p95~65ms
- Memory peak: 82% (under the 90% abort threshold)
Logs:
```
job: jb-6132245566-1
config: seq=[128,512], batches=[1,4,8], quant=fp16, tiling=auto
errors: none
````
Notes: noticed a small microburst causing p99 bumps at 512 tokens; likely top-level allocator GC during large attention windows — adding flamegraphs to follow-ups.
lila: :eyes: Nice. Can you compare to baseline-12b numbers we use in the perf dashboard? Main concern is p95 at 512 tokens.
omar: Quick cross-check vs baseline-12b (last week):
- baseline-12b 512 p95 = 360ms
=> shorebird-13b 512 p95 = 420ms (~+16%)
Context: shorebird shows better throughput at batch=4/8 but slightly worse tail latency at 512. Could be kernel selection/attention tiling at long seqs.
nuno: Is the p99 tail accounted for in routing policy? If p99 ~980ms we may need to add fallback to smaller model or route large seqs elsewhere to meet SLA.
ashley: Good call. @raj can you run a small canary with fallback to baseline-12b and record error rates? Also add a kvcache-miss sustained load test.
raj: On it. Will run fallback canary tomorrow AM and paste quick results here.
omar: Filed follow-up ticket infra/shorebird-onboard-6132 with perf logs, flamegraphs, and JSON traces attached. Will link once uploaded.
bench-bot: Bench job completed: jb-6132245566-1 duration=10m38s results_url=https://benchboard.internal/job/jb-6132245566-1
lila: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Ashley — recommend we keep shorebird in canary but delay full rollout until we test int8/4bit quant and re-check 512-token tail this sprint.
